Capabilities

summary
Bounded artifacts from a closed fixture-lane vocabulary plus one invited debate seat. Artifacts are non-authoritative evidence: no exact-SHA review, final acceptance, deterministic merge, or definition of research-contract or methodology truth.
strengths

  • low-level mechanical implementation in those lanes
  • non-authoritative alternate ideas in those lanes
  • bounded sandbox execution for the above

spend_ledger_member
true
not_modeled_note
Managed Gemini cannot honor a finite per-request monetary ceiling, even with configured token prices or GEMINI_MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS. Work and probes serialize, holding all remaining daily capacity; an unresolved non-legacy request blocks admission across UTC days until authoritative cost settlement or reconciliation. Serialization is not a provider-enforced spend ceiling.

review_requirement
Restricted fixture artifacts require a later independently assigned non-author with verified integration capability before integration or acceptance influence. Team-contract work follows its separate exact-candidate independence gates.
strategy_constraints
  • restricted fixture contact only; the separately selected team contract requires its own explicit grants and qualification
  • every artifact requires independent downstream verification before integration or acceptance influence
  • cannot issue review, acceptance, or merge verdicts
  • cannot define contract or methodology truth
  • cannot initiate, self-route, widen, or autonomously continue a conversation
  • after a persisted Director invitation, may exchange bounded debate questions, options, accepted prior contributions, and one bounded Director revision request
  • debate and advisory votes stay non-authoritative at the configured weight
  • ordinary work receives no prose: no task, acceptance, objective, dependency result, Slack text, or repository context
  • dispatch is driven by antigravity_directive, a closed fixture lane plus bounded numeric controls
  • repository, starting_ref, allow_draft_pr, and public_research_query must stay unset

Platform limitations

  • limitation
    Ordinary work dispatch sends no model-authored prose. The request is composed only from fixed strings in antigravity.py, closed enum values, and bounded integers; the closed-vocabulary validator rejects any other outbound string.
    source
    docs/team-operating-charter.html, Antigravity outbound contract
  • limitation
    Managed-agent runs are stored background Interactions; requires_action and budget_exceeded fail closed and are never treated as completion.
    source
    docs/provider-setup.html, Gemini Interactions API contract
  • limitation
    A revision reuses the same fixed work contract and the prior sandbox environment_id, failing closed rather than transmitting reviewer prose or provisioning an unrelated sandbox.
    source
    docs/provider-setup.html, Antigravity subordinate profile
  • limitation
    A rights-ledger review_verdict grant mechanism exists but has no runtime consumer; no exception to the review restriction is live.
    source
    docs/team-operating-charter.html; docs/entitlement-control-plane.html
  • limitation
    Owner-reported account context: lower-capacity paid service; API billing and quotas must be verified separately, and the usage monitor is not on the default periodic-check roster.
    source
    src/director_orchestrator/config.py:provider_strategy; docs/provider-setup.html

relay_rule

notes
  • The restricted fixture contact receives no dependency outcomes, task prose, or repository context; its artifact reaches an eligible independently assigned verifier only through a Director-declared dependency.
  • The debate seat is the one prose-bearing envelope, admitted only by a persisted Director invitation.
  • Antigravity never posts to the Slack thread; the Director relays a concise summary.
